evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: we talked to a lot of people everyday. And most of them would mention one or two concerns either they're worried the movers won't show up on time or they're going to damage the items. What about you, what either of this a concern to you?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Joseph said 'I mean, I wouldn't take a concern but it would be obviously problematic if either happens' — Amy acknowledged but asked no follow-up, moved straight to delivering promises.
evidence_quotes.value_days: it's actually one of our best value days or in other words the cheapest rate. So for Mondays, we charge $208.208 per hour
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: if you are ready to lock this date, we don't require any deposits, no rebooking, no cancellation fees will start in the morning around 8:30 to nine arrival, you'd like us to help out with the move. Joseph: Perfect. Yes, let's do it.

top_strength: Amy delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) in full, recognizable form with clear terms, and anchored the estimate with a specific dollar range ($1,645–$2,061) personalized to the customer's packing and moving hours.
coaching_note: The two-concerns question landed well, but when Joseph signaled a concern ('obviously problematic if either happens'), Amy pivoted immediately to the promises instead of probing two layers deep to understand what specifically worried him—missing the chance to address his real anxiety before the commitments.
